sodium chloride.t: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS Clindamycin Phosphate in Sodium Chloride Injection is contraindicated in individuals with a history of hypersensitivity to preparations containing clindamycin or lincomycin.
Avoid use of Clindamycin Phosphate in Sodium Chloride Injection in individuals with a history of gastrointestinal disease, particularly colitis.
